feature_name: Java 7 API compatibility for Java 8 runtime
summary: The Java 8 runtime maintains compatibility with Java 7 App Engine features and built-in APIs.
extended_definition: The Java 8 runtime maintains compatibility with Java 7 App Engine features and built-in APIs.

Deploy Maven source projects to the Java runtime You can deploy your Maven project as source code and have it built and deployed using Google Cloud's buildpacks .
Framework compatibility With the App Engine Java runtime, you can deploy executable JAR files.
